scope: Provider-coordinated backup reads in independently owned Mac and iOS implementations.
defect: Restore read external picker URLs directly, so pending file-presenter saves were not coordinated.
fix: WorkspaceBackup.readFile holds security scope, coordinates the read, uses the coordinator-provided URL, validates file size and propagates coordination/read/parse errors. Both native backup forms call it on their existing detached worker; generation checks and deferred busy cleanup remain.

newCases: Direct read sees stale file; coordinated read triggers a real NSFilePresenter save and parses latest backup
Presenter save failure throws instead of silently reading stale backup
Missing file throws, then a later valid read succeeds
Oversized sparse file rejects before JSON decoding

builds.mac: signed Debug passed; deep strict signature verified
builds.ios: arm64 Simulator Debug passed, not installed
builds.warnings: Existing Swift actor-isolation and unused-result warnings remain; not a warning-free build claim.

limitations: Tests exercise actual Foundation coordination locally; no claim of iOS external-provider or offline native acceptance.
Earlier Mac iCloud native upload/download/restore receipt predates this change and is not counted as a runtime pass of this build.
dataScope: Synthetic temporary files only. No app was replaced or installed and no account data were edited.
